title: Clarification of use of crypto?
body:
Hi  There,

Really good idea for a protocol but I'm somewhat concerned by how your apparent useage of AEAD in the protocol.

1/ I can see a static private_key variable apparently included in both the server & client source, if it really is a private key then sharing it like this means its no longer private.

2/ When the private_key variable is used in crypto_aead_chacha20poly1305_encrypt function as parameter key it is I believe is expecting a symmetric key and not an asymmetric private key.

nodes.body:
Thanks. 

In a real application, the private key is a symmetric key known only to to the web backend (which generates the connect token), and the dedicated server instances.

At no point does the client know the private key.

Unfortunately, due to a lack of time, the client.c also knows the private key and generates a connect token directly. This is not meant as an example of usage, but as a test case so I could quickly verify client connection is working correctly. 

Normally, the client would request a connect token from a web backend over a REST call, and pass that connect token into the connect call. The security models relies on the client not knowing the private key.

cheers
